data.title: Reduce the test runner memory peak
data.text:
The test job exceeded its memory limit when all bundles loaded together. The runner now loads bounded batches and preserves the same test coverage.

## Validation
- The focused suite passes.
- The sample memory peak fell from 1.8 GB to 1.1 GB.

## Next
Wait for full CI and review.
